title: Pulan Visaranai
desc: After being falsely suspended from duty, a disgraced investigating officer tracks down an auto driver notorious for kidnapping women.

title: Dishyum
desc: Bhaskar, a stuntman, is smitten with Cinthya, a college student. However, his heart is broken when he learns that she doesn't love him back but he still tries to persuade her.

title: Pattukku Oru Thalaivan
desc: Devastated by Shanthi's rejection, Arivu turns to alcoholism to drown his despair. However, beneath her silence lies a hidden truth that could shatter their past and redefine their futures.

title: Ini Oru Vidhi Seivom
desc: A cop wants his son to become a high-ranking police officer despite his disinterest but his death changes things. Bent on seeking vengeance, the son takes a path of violence to set things right.

title: Autograph
desc: Senthil, an advertising executive, decides to invite his old friends to his wedding. His past is unraveled as he sets out on a journey to meet his old friends and lovers.
